text: Build the REAL current private contest source candidate, no hardware, no publication. Time sensitive. Read existing submission-refresh-worker/readiness-report.md and its reviewed refresh_snapshot.py/verify_receiver.py first. Root has already run real inventory: /home/regex/work/esp32s31-submission-inventory-e403-v1/inventory.json. Reuse it. Original maintained source /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/openvela-dev and contest manifest contest2026_497_nitelabu/workspace/manifest-locked.xml. Need a concrete current binary-patch/new-source candidate and verification, not another recommendation report. Root handles offline full source export/build and dependency bridge; you own manifest project changes only. Keep original workspace and contest payload read-only. Output scripts/reports under your task directory, real candidate under a new /home/regex/work/esp32s31-contest-candidate-e403-* directory (root filesystem ONLY ~740MiB free; use small patches not full checkout). /mnt/wsl is writable tmpfs with16GB; a private directory there can hold temporary tiny objects and disposable receiver if needed, but final payload must be preserved on disk. D has452GB free but lacks Unix mode semantics. Inventory currently includes many upstream gitlinks/oversized unmodified testdata, generated Kconfig files, and parent tracked .gitignore crossing nested project. Resolve these without discarding maintained changes or changing public pins. Conservative generator can be enhanced in your own output to pass through UNCHANGED public-baseline gitlinks/large files and record intentional boundary-shadowed baseline files, rather than requiring unrelated submodules. Review tracked differences, explicitly include reviewed maintained new source and configs/resources; omit generated Kconfig/.kconfig/cache/private files with reasons. Do not blind autoapprove inventory. Inspect new-file purposes/provenance/license groups; preserve all relevant hardware/service work. Bounded scans, no whole backups/rawlogs. Final product must capture all eligible changes from manifest pins including local commits. Verify patches via fresh private indexes and reconstruct changed files; if full receiver cannot fit, prove actual changed-file bytes and disclose unchanged-public checkout scope. Preserve original helper/fixture evidence. Final readiness-report should state concrete output/hash/counts and exact remaining gaps. You may correct your own generator, no need endless mirror tests. Native factory source includes195files; compile sources frozen, root may correct only resource NOTICE documentation. If that NOTICE changes, recapture exact byte at final generation. No network, serial, USB/IP, live build, source edits or pushes.
我会先读取现有报告和已审查脚本，复用现成 inventory，核对 manifest 项目的实际差异与新增文件，再生成并验证磁盘上的小型候选补丁包。原工作区和现有 contest payload 保持只读，不使用网络或硬件。
现成 inventory 已读取。主要阻塞是未变更的上游 gitlink、大型测试数据，以及父项目 `.gitignore` 跨越嵌套项目边界。我正在核实这些项并在任务目录内修正生成器；新增源码与许可证审查、已跟踪差异审查和独立重建验证已并行展开。
已发现两处需要保留的细节：父项目在 NIST 嵌套目录内还有一项真实的本地 CMake 提交，不能一并跳过；板级 HMI 的 `.pem` 是构建引用的公开根证书，需要从私钥文件排除规则中作精确例外。factory 另出现了许可证说明文档，我会核实并捕获其最终字节。
逐项审查已完成：611 个新增源码、配置和资源文件获准纳入，163 个生成文件按明确原因省略。补丁将包含相对 manifest pin 的 695 个已跟踪路径差异，覆盖 115 个本地提交的最终效果。候选正在根文件系统生成，临时 Git 对象放在 `/mnt/wsl`；随后独立验证器会重新应用补丁并核对重建字节。
